name: docker

image.description: Docker image to use for the container

containerName.description: Container name (auto-generated from agent ID if not provided)

workspaceHost.description: Host directory to mount as workspace (required)

commandTimeoutMs.description: Default command timeout in milliseconds (30 seconds)

maxCommandTimeoutMs.description: Maximum allowed command timeout in milliseconds (5 minutes)

autoStart.description: Automatically start container on service initialization

autoPull.description: Automatically pull Docker image if not present

lazy.description: Lazy-load the service (don't initialize until first use)

enableBidirectional.description: Enable container-to-agent messaging via HTTP API

ampelosApiUrl.description: Ampelos API URL for container callbacks (auto-configured if not provided)

ampelosApiPort.description: Ampelos API port for container callbacks

setupCallbackScript.description: Automatically create callback scripts in workspace on container start

description: Docker container service for isolated filesystem access, command execution, and bidirectional agent communication
